purpose: Construct finite canonical local scalar realizations and quantify the joint static/noise approximation; no experimental fitting.
units: ell=1; all distances and inverse frequencies scaled by ell
hypotheses: a single common linear matter current
Gaussian spatial profile with Fourier amplitude exp(-a^2 k^2/2)
test_rule: Check positive normalized weights, Gaussian quadrature static error enclosures, and uniform absolute potential/force/noise error bounds for positive midpoint bins plus one tail atom. Low-frequency relative noise is separately reported, never inferred from static agreement.
exposure: All parameter choices are synthetic model-development choices before execution. No observational data or fitted couplings are used.
physical_gaps: selection of spectral measure and matter couplings
finite field count and gravitational EFT cutoff
